description: Java class TbMailSender extending JavaMailSenderImpl, handling SMTP email sending with OAuth2 support, token refresh, and connection testing within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: TbMailSender
classes.description: A JavaMailSender implementation with OAuth2 token management and SMTP configuration for Thingsboard.

methods.name: TbMailSender
methods.description: Constructor initializing SMTP settings and OAuth2 configuration based on JSON config.

methods.name: doSend
methods.description: Overrides mail sending to update OAuth2 token if expired before sending.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Overrides connection test to refresh OAuth2 token if needed.

methods.name: updateOauth2PasswordIfExpired
methods.description: Checks if OAuth2 token is expired and refreshes it if necessary.

methods.name: createJavaMailProperties
methods.description: Creates SMTP properties including TLS, proxy, and OAuth2 mechanisms based on JSON config.

methods.name: refreshAccessToken
methods.description: Refreshes OAuth2 access token using stored refresh token and updates settings.

methods.name: parsePort
methods.description: Parses SMTP port from string, throws exception if invalid.
